name: CT secondary burden allocation reference
summary: Associates the connected measurement loads with the assigned CT secondary circuit.
description: Associates the connected measurement loads with the assigned CT secondary circuit. A current-transformer secondary arrangement carries a measuring current from a defined primary location to metering or protection inputs. Core identity, polarity and the connected circuit determine the measurement's meaning.

In a substation protection panel, separate CT cores can supply metering and protection circuits with different duties. A test boundary must preserve the secondary arrangement required by the selected CT and test device. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Connected secondary devices” at the input and “Burden allocation information” at the output. Actual burden requires the complete circuit data.

Trace every secondary connection and the assigned earthing point against the actual connection diagram. These illustrations explain circuit roles and never prescribe a live CT switching or disconnection procedure. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
